name: usd-checkout
description: Price invoices in US dollars and get paid in HBAR. A Hardhat + Next.js template where a Pyth oracle price is load-bearing: the payer submits a fresh Pyth update with the payment, and the contract converts the dollar amount to HBAR on the spot.

envVars.description: Needed for live Pyth quotes only, not for demo oracle mode (packages/nextjs/.env.local). Pyth Hermes API key, sent by the server route /api/hermes as a Bearer token. The key must be allowed to read the HBAR/USD feed. Server only: never prefix it with NEXT_PUBLIC_. Get one in Pyth Terminal (https://app.pyth.com); see https://docs.pyth.network/price-feeds/core/upgrade/preparing.
Optional (packages/nextjs/.env.local). Pyth Hermes instance that serves signed price updates. Defaults to https://pyth.dourolabs.app/hermes.

Optional (set in your shell when deploying). Set to true to deploy against Pyth's MockPyth instead of the real Pyth contract, so the whole payment flow works without a Pyth API key. Prices are typed in by the payer. Testnet and local chains only: the deploy script refuses it on mainnet.
Optional (packages/nextjs/.env.local). JSON-RPC endpoint for Hedera testnet. Defaults to https://testnet.hashio.io/api.
Optional (packages/hardhat/.env). Override the Pyth contract address used at deploy time. Defaults to the Hedera deployment 0xA2aa501b19aff244D90cc15a4Cf739D2725B5729.
Optional (packages/hardhat/.env). Override the Pyth HBAR/USD price feed id used at deploy time.

steps.label: Run the contract tests (no network needed)
Generate a deployer account (prints its address; the key is stored encrypted)
Fund that address with testnet HBAR

steps.text: No Pyth API key that covers HBAR/USD? Set DEMO_ORACLE=true in your shell before the deploy command to use the demo oracle (see 'Oracle modes' in the README).
